title: 示例素材 · 论文阅读与讨论
description: 4 句原创讨论表达，练习读摘要、提出设计问题和区分关联与因果。

sentences.en: The abstract gives a brief overview of the research question.
sentences.zh: 摘要简要概述了研究问题。
sentences.note: an overview of 用于概括主题；brief 强调简要。
sentences.question: How would you summarize the research question in one sentence?

chunks.en: a brief overview of the research question

sentences.en: I would like to understand how the authors selected their samples.
sentences.zh: 我想了解作者是如何选择样本的。
sentences.note: I would like to understand 用于礼貌提出方法问题。
sentences.question: What would you check about the sample selection process?

chunks.en: how the authors selected their samples

sentences.en: An observed association does not by itself establish a causal relationship.
sentences.zh: 观察到的关联本身并不能确立因果关系。
sentences.note: by itself 限定证据力度；association 与 causal relationship 的含义不同。
sentences.question: What additional evidence would support a causal explanation?

sentences.en: The discussion should connect the findings to the original research question.
sentences.zh: 讨论部分应将研究发现与最初的研究问题联系起来。
sentences.note: connect A to B 表示把两者联系起来。
sentences.question: How do the main findings address the original question?
